16.en: Mare Cinis is in lockdown, and a botched attack by a rogue Interrogator is halted at the last minute. Servitors repair sections of the base marred by traces of explosives while Inquisitorial retinues stand vigil, their Patrons not yet confident that the threat has passed.

26.en: In attendance at the third Conclave are: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn}, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Kai Varol}, and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek}. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud} is absent but is represented by her Interrogator, Damien Savantas, who reports that Inquisitor Raud is occupied with an investigation in the Drimor Subsector.

34.en: In @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud}’s absence, Kai Varol (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}) believes he has greater freedom to act. The @UUID[.ugwIBQXf8tEWYSE0#strife-ii-b-the-drake-archive]{Drake Archive} has shed little light on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst}’s possible involvement in the Inquisitor Lord’s death.

38.en: may contact the characters, requesting they infiltrate the section of the base occupied by

46.en: However, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} is not unrepresented at the Conclave. The characters may be approached by Damien Savantas, who seeks to recruit their support in hunting @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}. He has been interrogating Tarran Selvir for many years (the acolyte who returned with news of Thracius’ alleged death).

50.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Raud} has learned that @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Thracius} was one of multiple identities attributed to the same individual and that he may not be dead after all.

58.en: is working within the Conclave under another false identity but remains uncertain who this imposter may be, asking the characters whether they have any suspicions and offering to meet again if they believe they have learned anything pertinent..

62.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.CbYL1IrXodXyGuyV]{Sylvestrine Horst} has appointed an Interrogator: Yorin Veldir, an inscrutable individual wearing a mask of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW]{Saint Macharius}. The characters' Patron is eager to know what information can be gathered about them, as this Interrogator is currently an uncertain factor for the Conclave. Those who dig into Interrogator Veldir’s past may learn that

66.en: recruited them from the @UUID[Compendium.impmal-starter-set.journals.JournalEntry.WE1MLa1KVRHMD8wJ.JournalEntryPage.P8rukYyQeyPJ1ubs]{Imperial Navy} and that they served as an officer aboard one of the vessels that enacted

70.en: upon @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.lpu6iuTHw50UavbI]{Belnshudha} (the planet where Inquisitor Lord Drake met his demise).

92.en: A rogue Interrogator has fled Mare Cinis after their botched attack on the Conclave, which, if successful, could have slain the entire Macharian Inquisition.

100.en: Arnaut Cisneros, Interrogator to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranu}s, attempted to sabotage @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} but was caught in the act, detonating the explosives they had already planted to cover their escape, and fleeing to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.qLLaIGWiU6Lf6Rjy]{Persepolis} below.

108.en: To the gathered Conclave, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} declares Cisneros

112.en: , with the full support of each other Inquisitor present.

120.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} is infuriated, particularly as he was already preparing to undertake a key operation when the attack occurred; this setback may cost him valuable time in his investigations of a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} bearing striking resemblance to that found on @UUID[.qMGtMcmwPnXnwPds#strife-i-c-the-fate-of-the-lucanus]{Calvus Station}.

128.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus} asserts that his current investigation is of such importance that it cannot wait for him to recover the heretic Interrogator, a claim supported by @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Kai Varol}, who first uncovered the lead that Serranus is pursuing. While he is reluctant to shift the responsibility of eliminating Cisneros to another, his hand is forced, and he requests the aid of the Conclave.

148.en: The characters begin their chase across Persepolis, plumbing the depths of Hive Valios to find the escaped Interrogator and catch them before they can do anything worse.

154.en: Characters pursuing Cisneros may wish to examine @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis}'s voidship flight records. Shortly after the attack, a small transport departed the base; the tracking data suggests it crashed on the planet below, on the outskirts of Hive Valios. Given Cisneros’ status as

158.en: , their movements will be severely limited. However, locating Cisneros may become a near-insurmountable task if they entered the decaying industrial labyrinth of Valios’ lower hive levels.

162.en: On the surface, a trail of malfunctioning machinery on the hive edge leads characters into the lower hive. Limited enforcer presence and the endless winding tunnels require the characters to work with local guides and bounty hunters. They must track the rogue Interrogator’s movements across decaying zones and industrial complexes filled with desperate, impoverished wretches.

166.en: The trail left by Cisneros suggests a link between their treachery and the @UUID[.ugwIBQXf8tEWYSE0#strife-ii-c-the-eskutchax-incongruity]{Daemon Engine core} found on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.jB9sg2SDLZJGZrac]{Eskutchax}. Cisneros, infected with daemonic scrap code, first reported this incident at the second Conclave after returning from Eskutchax. Due to Inquisitor @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Serranus}’ practice of augmenting his acolytes, the daemon was able to inhabit Cisneros' augmetics and wrest control of what flesh remained. Cisneros remains conscious, trapped in their own body.

170.en: The daemon seeks to infect the hive’s cogitator network with scrap code. The few Cisneros sightings reported by lower hive citizens have been at cogitator arrays, servitor colonies, and datavaults. However, as the daemon finds these systems disused or disconnected from the hive’s wider cogitator network, its actions have become increasingly erratic. The characters learn from the hive’s Tech-Priests that Cisneros found a tech reliquary containing @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.px7pplClKR01chqM]{Servitors} and @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.Y6oJff3F4qo2Xhlx]{Servo-skulls}, infecting them all.

174.en: If located, the first instinct of the possessed Cisneros is to flee. If cornered, the daemon fights to the death — its hosts, rather than its own — dominating any nearby industrial machinery to defend itself.

182.en: Characters who destroy Cisneros demonstrate the capability of their Patron to resolve other Inquisitors’ problems, earning them +1 Legitimacy. @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} is greatly appreciative and more willing to work with the characters’ Patron, particularly concerning the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-heralds-howl]{Herald’s Howl}. If recovered alive, Cisneros provides valuable information on

186.en: ’ actions. However, Cisneros has been declared

190.en: , putting the characters and their Patron under suspicion as possible traitors themselves if they provide shelter.

194.en: If his hand is forced, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} sends his own acolytes to destroy Arnaut Cisneros, losing both a potentially valuable lead in investigating the Herald’s Howl and multiple operatives, whose augmetics make them ill-equipped to face the scrap code-infected Interrogator (he gains no Legitimacy).

208.en: The Return of Knight Commander Justinian

216.en: The Inquisition is urged to investigate strange occurrences on Xenophon after the disappearance and subsequent reappearance of one of their most distinguished officers.

224.en: A Castellan from the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum}, Jak Greiss, comes before the Conclave to petition aid from the Inquisition. The famous Knight Commander Justinian was found clinging to driftwood by Astra Militarum troops, allegedly having escaped tortuous captivity beneath the oceans of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.si7mc5k5MVLqN049]{Xenophon}. The Commander’s mind and body have both suffered horrendously from the torture inflicted upon him by his captors; he has only been able to recount being dragged into the oceans by a group of Xenophonians. However, he struggles to remember what transpired after that and who kept him captive after being thrown, weighted, into the sublime green ocean.

232.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.si7mc5k5MVLqN049]{Xenophon} is designated a garden world, with more water than landmass. It presents hazards in its marine flora and fauna, which have claimed the lives of many careless officers taking leave on the planet over the years. However, these recent events shed light on potential heretic or xenos activity on the planet.

240.en: Given that what exactly befell Knight Commander Justinian in the oceans of Xenophon remains uncertain, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.W50MW8gfyrDts9g3]{Aegidius Halikarn} suggests a decoy operation — send an acolyte with a false identity to bait the heretics, tricking them into kidnapping another supposed @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} officer, thereby revealing their identification, and path to elimination.

248.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Kai Varol’s} concerns lie with sending acolytes to investigate what occurred after the cultists left the Commander to sink beneath the waves, for indeed, whatever shadow has hold over Xenophon originates in those dark waters.

262.en: Characters depart to Xenophon to begin their investigation, soon to plunge into a worldwide conspiracy involving a cult of Drukhari-worshipping locals.

268.en: Characters can talk to Castellan Greiss before they depart to gain more insight into Justinian. He is a tank commander who survived countless battles fighting heretics at the edge of the sector. He has a phobia of deep water and was reluctant to take leave on Xenophon.

278.en: Garden worlds are among the rarest planets in the galaxy — those few naturally suited to sustaining Human life with no terraforming required. These veritable paradises are often protected to retain their natural beauty and atmosphere; even the boot of the Imperium knows to tread lightly on them. As such, populations are kept relatively low, and these planets are used as training bases or for recreational use. Experiencing life on such a world is a rare blessing for anyone who can.

284.en: He is in a near catatonic state, under heavy guard in his leave-housing on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.si7mc5k5MVLqN049]{Xenophon}. If questioned as to why the Castellan has requested the Inquisition’s aid, he claims that the locals are challenging to deal with, and due to the planet’s draw as a shore leave destination, its governing bodies hold too much sway with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} and might interfere with an internal investigation.

288.en: If characters choose to masquerade as @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} officers or observe other officers taking leave on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.si7mc5k5MVLqN049]{Xenophon}, they will find that isolated officers are sometimes kidnapped at night by a group that throws their victims into the ocean, sacrifices to beings they call the Pearl-eyed Ones. Unaware of Justinian’s status, the cultists kidnapped and subsequently released him in an attempt to avoid scrutiny. This cost the cultists dearly in the eyes of their masters.

292.en: Characters may investigate beneath the waves by diving or submersible, though the latter will arouse suspicion among the cultists. Diving below the coral reefs, characters find ancient Aeldari structures centred around an inactive Webway portal. The @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} are using it to collect victims offered to them by the Xenophonian cultists.

296.en: The cult has ritually sacrificed people to the Drukhari since before the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.X5EFP7IgIUx6CaBW#the-macharian-conquests]{Macharian Crusade}. It is deeply ingrained into local culture, and even the Planetary Governor works with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari}. Many locals know of the practice, a tradition they carefully conceal. This relationship is built on generations of ritual and maintained by both sides, with the Drukhari eliminating any threats to this supply of victims. If the cultists become aware they are under investigation, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.b8x4YQfSyzlvU4LX]{Drukhari Kabalite Warriors} move to eliminate the investigators.

300.en: With a captured or slain Drukhari in hand, characters may be able to call military support from their Patron’s allies, as well as mobilise visiting @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum} forces against the xenos-allied cultists and Drukhari. Should their Webway portal come under attack, the Drukhari withdraw from Xenophon entirely, offering the cultists safety from the Imperial forces if they follow them — a final cruel ploy for one last batch of victims.

308.en: Ending the cultic activity on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.si7mc5k5MVLqN049]{Xenophon} by eliminating the cultists or breaking the Drukhari hold over the world earns the characters’ Patron +1 Legitimacy and +1 Influence with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum}.

312.en: Failing to identify the cultists or the Drukhari influencing them from beneath the waves will allow the killings to continue, gradually eroding the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.6Yav4onpokz5e5jg]{Astra Militarum’s} body of officers in the Macharian Sector.

316.en: If no other Inquisitor undertakes this operation, it falls to Kai Varol (@UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.y8Wjo2ThhVq782nY]{Eskender Thracius}), who gains +1 Legitimacy on completion of the mission. In discovering xenos involvement,

320.en: aquires further understanding of the Webway. It eventually benefits his experiments with @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#aeldari]{Aeldari} technology, developing into a means of covert travel and access to Aeldari sites.

346.en: , has stalled above Jotungarth. The psykers aboard exhibit the same unnerving behaviour — each is emitting a beautiful and inscrutable psychic song blocking the light of the Astronomican from the ship’s navigator.

354.en: An @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica} voidship has been cordoned off by the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.HlxK2pbpx2Uio6bU]{Imperial Fleet}. Psykers aboard continue to deteriorate, their condition threatening to end all navigation to and from @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth}.

362.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} sees investigating the vessel and planet as imperative. Given her connections to the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica}, she is concerned that the corruption of these psykers may spread to others. However, psykers lead

366.en: acolytes and are at considerable risk of corruption if they investigate.

374.en: @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus} suggests the ship be immediately destroyed; what is the loss of a few psykers when the whole sector is already rife with them? Let the debris fall into the frozen waters of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth} and be forgotten. Navigators on nearby vessels have already begun to notice the discordant song.

388.en: Characters depart for Jotungarth to investigate the stranded Black Ship. They will soon discover the consequences of Inquisitor Lord Hieronymo Drake’s actions and learn more about the dead Inquisitor’s past.

394.en: Before departure, @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.sNDdDGlvY5m1HQ4R]{Ksenia Baek} suggests that the characters contact Knight-Centura Augustina aboard the

398.en: . If the players or their Patron are in good standing with Baek, she also offers the services of a @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-actors.Actor.CBLdHnFWFqdhfRKx]{Sister of Silence} from her retinue to accompany them.

402.en: Aboard the Black Ship, the characters’ first experience boarding the vessel will be the singing echoing through the decks, both audible in realspace and their minds, unless in the presence of a blank. If characters meet Knight-Centura Augustina, she informs them that the psychic song began when the Black Ship arrived in orbit around @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth}. The characters can investigate the ship and conclude that nothing is amiss mechanically. A psyker who risks exposure to the song can tell it originates on Jotungarth itself.

406.en: Deploying to the surface of @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.wHl3ZP7wM7OQvSLC]{Jotungarth}, characters discover widespread psychic awakenings, unnatural phenomena, and even minor daemonic activity throughout the planet’s city-vessels. These all originate with those who have heard the same psychic song, and any psychically attuned members of the party will be aware of it too. As they aid city-vessel authorities in tackling these events, they must find a way to track and pinpoint the psychic song. Quelling enough psychic activity will ‘clear the air’ and lead them to the source. Additionally, Jotungarth has an abundance of master seers and oracles that could aid in pinpointing the phenomena; many will be distressed by this psychic signal and eager to help. The characters could work with local astropath choirs to attempt to overcome the daemonic song with a hymn of their own, or assemble enough sanctioned psykers to divine the location of the source through a dangerous psychic ritual.

410.en: Characters can track the ultimate source of the psychic song to a remote and hidden bastion, buried within a massive iceberg bearing Inquisition insignia. Automated defences guard the facility but will surrender and open itself to anyone with vermillion-level clearance. It soon becomes apparent that the facility belonged to Inquisitor Lord Hieronymo Drake. He was using the facility to study the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.M6XWkYc0lfuKl2hU]{Daemonhost} he captured within. Since Drake’s death, the solitary daemon has loosened its bonds, freeing its psychic voice to reach others nearby.

420.en: The Black Ships of the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica} travel the Imperium, charged with collecting and transporting psykers back to Terra to fulfil the God-Emperor’s Tithe. These massive dread galleons are effectively prison vessels. Their cavernous holds are filled with psyker containment units and other tools to combat Warp manifestations, an oppressive backdrop to the screams of the lost and the damned that echo their halls. Each crew member must be capable of withstanding psychic influence — whether by extensive mental augmetics, the Pariah Gene, or being a powerful psyker in their own right.

426.en: Several parts of Drake's research point to cults on @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.lpu6iuTHw50UavbI]{Belnshudha}, suggesting that he allowed their heretical activites to thrive for some time. Also, it indicates that Drake extracted the daemonhost from Belnshudha some time ago. Other aspects of his research here point to the @UUID[.jt0zc7az5xNehcIZ#the-kryptman-protocol]{Kryptman Protocol}, seeking ways to turn the daemonhost’s power into a weapon of

430.en: . Characters find more cyphers and keys; they can return them to @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} to further research on the Drake Archive.

438.en: Characters must decide what to do with the daemonhost. Return with it to @UUID[.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis}, hand it over to @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.9vSAxxrma5zbEIKL]{Alis Raud}, or destroy it. Whatever outcome here, their Patron earns +1 Legitimacy and +1 Influence with the @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.6hX0E9XlPUoRaDaQ.JournalEntryPage.upGG1JZPDbC7dpJJ]{Adeptus Astra Telepathica}. The

442.en: is free to continue on the long way back to Holy Terra.

460.en: In the wake of Cisneros’ attack, the Inquisitors hesitate to attend the following Conclave, particularly @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.b06xyMjo4E4cYc40.JournalEntryPage.gRAiiRJkLKviH0K5]{Konstan Serranus}, although his desire to be elsewhere is driven by growing @UUID[Compendium.navis-apexialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#tyranids]{Genestealer Cult} activity.
